youtube.baslik: Does tele-audiology always mean a live video call? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Tele-audiology is the remote delivery of audiology services through communication technologies. In synchronous service, the audiologist and patient are connected at the same time; in asynchronous service, data such as video otoscopy images or automated audiograms are first collected and then reviewed by the specialist; in a hybrid model, data are collected in advance and results are shared in a live call. Tele-audiology does not replace in-person care; used with the right patient and for the right purpose, it complements it.
